answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 21232 Country: United Kingdom Title: If a person, as part of a conversation, not referring to himself and not knowing the meaning of what he is saying states my name is Avatar does this constitute kufr & invalidate nikah. Obviously the intention was not to commit kufr. I am really worried and would be grateful for a quick response Question: If a person, as part of a conversation, not referring to himself and not knowing the meaning of what he is saying states my name is Avatar does this constitute kufr & invalidate nikah. Obviously the intention was not to commit kufr. I am really worried and would be grateful for a quick response Answer ID: 21232 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 475/475/M=1431) In the question mentioned above, there is no ruling of kufr and termination of nikah for him. However one should avoid saying such words. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
